leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a TypeScript interface to represent the shape of the application state
Construct a reducer function that accepts state and action parameters
Apply switch statements to handle different action types within the reducer
Implement action creators to generate consistent action objects
Use the createStore function to initialize the Redux store with the reducer
Invoke store methods to dispatch actions and update application state
Access the current state from the store using the getState method
Control state updates by returning new state objects instead of mutating existing state
Handle action payloads to modify specific parts of the state tree
Utilize TypeScript generics to type the store, actions, and state properly
Execute subscription callbacks to respond to state changes in the application
Return predictable state transformations that follow Redux principles
